titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Technology has completely changed the way we live and work. A few decades ago, people had to travel long distances or wait for weeks to send a message. Today, thanks to smartphones and the Internet, we can talk to anyone, anywhere, in a second. Machines and computers now do difficult tasks in factories, hospitals and offices, saving time and effort. However, technology also creates new problems. Many workers lose their jobs because machines replace them. People spend less time talking face to face and more time looking at screens. Some even feel lonely despite being connected to hundreds of "friends" online. Technology is a powerful tool, but we must never let it replace real human relationships.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) How did people communicate a few decades ago, according to the text?   (2 marks)
2) How has technology helped in factories, hospitals and offices?   (2 marks)
3) Give two problems created by technology.   (2 marks)
4) What warning does the writer give at the end?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the present perfect: Technology (change) ______ the way we live.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "must / mustn't": We ______ let technology replace human relationships.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (however / so): Technology is useful; ______, it creates new problems.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "connected" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Has technology made our lives better or worse?" Write a paragraph (about 8-10 lines) giving your opinion, with arguments and examples. Use linkers.
